description: The aux send and return section of the Chained Mixer: it feeds two external effects from the aux busses and mixes their returns back into the Master's output

params.text: Sets the level of the aux 1 return into the mix, silent at the bottom, 0dB at the marked position and 12dB at the top
Sets the level of the aux 2 return into the mix, silent at the bottom, 0dB at the marked position and 12dB at the top
Solos the aux 1 return: while it is on, every channel and the aux 2 return are dropped from the mix, though the sends keep running; the tooltip on it reads Solo AUX 2, which is the maker's mistake
Nothing in the module can move this button: the maker gave it no range, so the aux 2 return can never be soloed
Silences the aux 1 return; the tooltip on it reads Mute AUX 2, which is the maker's mistake
Nothing in the module can move this button: the maker gave it no range, so the aux 2 return can never be muted

inputs.text: The left return from the aux 1 effect, with polyphonic channels summed to one
The right return from the aux 1 effect; with one return jack alone patched the return is mixed in mono
The left return from the aux 2 effect, with polyphonic channels summed to one
The right return from the aux 2 effect; with one return jack alone patched the return is mixed in mono

outputs.text: The left aux 1 send, carrying each channel's aux 1 level through the Master's AUX1 knob
The right aux 1 send; with this jack alone patched it carries the aux 1 bus in mono
The left aux 2 send, carrying each channel's aux 2 level through the Master's AUX2 knob
The right aux 2 send; with this jack alone patched it carries the aux 2 bus in mono

notes: place it in the same unbroken run of Chained Mixer modules as a Master; on its own it does nothing
an aux bus is computed only while one of its send outputs is patched, so an unpatched send means a silent return as well
with two Aux modules in one run, only the leftmost of them is active
the AUX 2 solo and mute buttons were never given a parameter range by the maker, so they cannot be clicked and AUX 2 can be neither soloed nor muted
